definitions.gloss: to skip reading; to skim over
definitions.explanation: To intentionally skip parts of a text while reading, either because it seems unimportant or to save time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばした。
examples.english: I skipped over the difficult parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}→注意事項：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばさないで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't skip the precautions in the manual.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばして⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I didn't have time, so I skipped the middle and just read the ending.

notes:
A compound verb: ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) + ⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧ (to skip over). It describes deliberately passing over part of a text — the reader chooses to jump ahead, rather than missing something by accident.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the passage skipped: ⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす

ASPECT (ている):
{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばしている describes a reading session in progress in which the reader keeps skipping ahead. It does not describe a resulting state, so it is not used to mean "has skipped."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす (to skip ads)
- ⟦{長文|ちょうぶん}→長文：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす (to skim long texts)
- ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}な→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{飛|と}ばす (to skip boring chapters)

THE ～{飛|と}ばす PATTERN:
As the second half of a compound, ⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧ adds the sense of jumping over the material in between.
